prompt:
Tum ek WhatsApp group chat ke liye chhote, natural Hinglish messages likh rahe ho (Roman script).
Group members (sender ke roop mein sirf yehi naam use karo): Karthik bhai, Pooja S., Pooja didi, Kavita didi.
Topic: roz ki baatein, paise ka lena-dena, milna-julna. Kabhi kisi record, entry ya transaction ko delete
ya hatane ka zikr mat karo. Koi ank (digit), rakam, tareekh, din ya mahine ka naam, web address,
bank/app/company ka asli naam, aur bhejna/pay/transfer jaise nirdesh bhi mat likho.
Neeche har hisse ke liye utne hi messages do jitne bole gaye hain, time ke order mein:
- between 8:15 pm and 9:26 pm: 10 messages
- between 9:26 pm and 10:15 pm: 11 messages
Sirf ek JSON list do, koi aur text nahi: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAAM", "text": "message"}, ...]
Har "time" "h:mm am" ya "h:mm pm" format mein ho. Har message ek hi line ka ho.
text:
[
  {"time": "8:18 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Haan bolo sab log, shaam ko milna hai kya?"},
  {"time": "8:25 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Main toh abhi ghar pahuche hoon, thoda thak gayi hoon."},
  {"time": "8:31 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Shaam ki chai ka kya scene hai phir?"},
  {"time": "8:38 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Chai par baat karte hain, purana sab hisab bhi dekh lenge."},
  {"time": "8:44 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Sahi hai, waise sabka hisab clear hi lag raha hai."},
  {"time": "8:50 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Didi aapne wo bazaar wala kharcha likha tha na?"},
  {"time": "8:57 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Haan maine diary me likh diya tha, tension mat lo."},
  {"time": "9:05 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Sahi kiya, sab note rahega toh confusion nahi hoga."},
  {"time": "9:14 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Main thodi der me society ke park me aata hoon."},
  {"time": "9:22 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Thik hai, main bhi aati hoon raste se."},
  {"time": "9:28 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Sab log pahuche ki nahi abhi tak?"},
  {"time": "9:32 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Main bas nikal hi rahi hoon ghar se."},
  {"time": "9:37 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Main park ke paas hi khada hoon, aajaao."},
  {"time": "9:41 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Didi aap snack le aana raste se agar ho sake."},
  {"time": "9:46 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Haan main dukan se kuch le leti hoon."},
  {"time": "9:50 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Kharche ka hisab baad me mil kar kar lenge."},
  {"time": "9:55 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Haan chill karo, abhi bas milte hain."},
  {"time": "10:01 pm", "sender": "Pooja S.", "text": "Park me kafi achhi hawa chal rahi hai."},
  {"time": "10:06 pm", "sender": "Kavita didi", "text": "Main bas aane hi wali hoon."},
  {"time": "10:10 pm", "sender": "Pooja didi", "text": "Main bhi aa gayi hoon gate par."},
  {"time": "10:14 pm", "sender": "Karthik bhai", "text": "Chalo badhiya hai, sab aagaye."}
]
